skill_name: Suggest two methods to increase website conversions?
workflow: Two ways to increase website conversions include optimizing the layout of the website and reducing the number of steps required to complete a purchase. Optimizing the website layout means making sure the navigation is intuitive, the page design is eye-catching, and any out-of-date content is updated. Reducing the number of steps to complete a purchase may include streamlining the checkout process and offering different payment options. Additionally, providing relevant and timely customer service
